description: Audit a website's internal linking and hand back the fixes. Crawls the site (or imports a Screaming Frog export), finds orphan pages, under-linked priority pages, over-linked hubs, broken links, redirect chains, generic and repetitive anchors, then proposes concrete links (source page, target page, anchor text, draft sentence) and a top-20 action plan in one markdown report. Use when the user says "/internal-linking", "internal links", "internal linking audit", "orphan pages", "link equity", "anchor text audit", "which pages should link to X", "spread authority to this page", or asks why a page gets no internal links. Not for backlinks from other sites, and not for planning new content clusters (that is /seo-cluster).
